newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan group confirms seeking 18,500 T wheat.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan group confirms seeking 18,500 T wheat.

text.p: Moroccan millers group, Comite Professionnel de la Minoterie, is tendering for 18,500 tonnes of optional origin soft wheat for delivery in the second half of October, an official of the group said on Tuesday.
"Tenders were launched a few days ago and close tomorrow, Wednesday," she said. "Delivery is for the second half of this month."
No further details were immediately available.
